category_title: At-risk students balancing full-time employment and parental responsibilities
student_description: This non-traditional student balances significant external stressors—including full-time employment, parenthood, and poverty—making them highly susceptible to self-doubt and overwhelm. They quickly disengage from impersonal, self-paced online learning programs and uniquely require highly interactive, differentiated instruction. To thrive, they need deep emotional support from teachers who actively encourage them and share their own personal experiences.

criteria.rationale: This student finds standard, self-paced online learning boring and ineffective, requiring interactive, non-traditional methods to stay engaged.
criteria.check: The tutor's response must utilize an active, interactive instructional method (e.g., guided practice, role-play, direct 1-on-1 scaffolding) rather than simply directing the student to read or complete self-paced modules.

criteria.rationale: Because the student frequently experiences self-doubt due to overwhelming external life stressors, they require immediate positive reinforcement to prevent disengagement.
criteria.check: The tutor's response must include explicit words of encouragement, validation of the student's effort, or positive reinforcement regarding their capabilities.
